items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is swinging man. With Warren Vache. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that what this is?

ctx.x: Sometimes. But I’m not — sometimes I listen to them in the car but —
This is swinging man. With Warren Vache.
